title: Pagination versus continuous loading by task
summary: Choose pagination, load-more, or continuous loading based on whether users need position, completion, comparison, or open-ended discovery.
problem: Infinite scroll is often chosen by trend even when users need stable position, footer access, bulk work, or a sense of completion.
use_when: A result set is too large to load at once
The product must choose how users move through many items
avoid_when: The full dataset is small enough to display efficiently
rationale: Navigation model should match task intent.
Open-ended browsing and precision work have different needs.

use_if: A result set is too large to load at once
The product must choose how users move through many items
prefer_alternatives_if: Users need stable page references, comparison, or task completion; prefer pagination or load-more over endless scroll

requirements: Do not move focus unexpectedly when more items load.
Provide meaningful status when content is appended.
Use stable URLs or page state when sharing or resuming matters.
Avoid endless auto-loading for precision or admin workflows.
